findings.title: `website_name` bypasses the anonymous TL0 profile-field restriction
findings.body: `website` is explicitly treated as an untrusted attribute and is omitted when an anonymous user views a TL0 profile, but the new `website_name` attribute is not included in `untrusted_attributes`. As a result, those viewers still receive and the template displays the website hostname (and, for matching domains, its full path) even though the underlying website field is intentionally hidden. Add `website_name` to the restricted inclusion logic (and cover a TL0 anonymous profile with a website in the serializer spec) so the derived value cannot disclose the protected field.

findings.title: The website-name inclusion callback is not recognized by the serializer
findings.body: ActiveModel serializer inclusion callbacks use the `include_<attribute>?` form, as the other callbacks in this class do. This method is named `include_website_name` without the trailing `?`, so it is not used and `website_name` is serialized by default even for profiles with no website (or an unparsable website), producing an unexpected `website_name: null` API field. Rename it to `include_website_name?`; the predicate should also enforce the same visibility policy as `website`.
